title: The Drop of Vienna Revisited
author: Orsen Dravenmoor
blurb: Coral Thackeray, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
